Hello! :)

I am currently a Ph.D. student in **Biostatistics** at the University of Pennsylvania (Perelman School of Medicine) with research interests in **causal inference**, **missing data**, and **semiparametric theory**. I hope to use my expertise to develop robust methods for the analysis of observational studies that can be used in collaborative projects across the biomedical and education fields. I also hope to grow as an educator in statistics. 

## Collaborative Experience

- Biostatistics Student Analysis Core: University of Pennsylvania (2026-Present)
- [QSURE Intern](https://www.mskcc.org/departments/epidemiology-biostatistics/educational-opportunities/quantitative-sciences-summer-undergraduate-research-experience-qsure): Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (2025)
- [Statistics and Data Science Fellow](https://www.amherst.edu/academiclife/departments/statistics/major-in-statistics/statistics-fellows): Amherst College (2024-2026)
- [Follette Education Lab](https://www.follettelab.com/education-research): Amherst College (2023-2026)

## Education

- Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) in **Biostatistics**: University of Pennsylvania (Exp. 2031)
- Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) in **Mathematics and Music**: Amherst College (2026)
